subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Bank Impersonation Scam
description: One-minute skill: The Bank Impersonation Scam.

hook.text: Your bank texts about suspicious activity. You click the link and enter your login. Game over.

buildup.text: Bank impersonation scams use texts, calls, and emails that perfectly mimic your real bank.

discovery.text: The fake login page captures your credentials in real time, giving scammers instant access.

twist.text: Some scammers call simultaneously, posing as bank agents, to guide you through 'security steps.'

climax.text: Banks say they will never ask for your full password, PIN, or one-time codes by phone or text.

punchline.text: Your bank already knows your password. They'd never ask for it.

quiz.question: What should you do if you receive a suspicious text from your bank?
options: Call the number in the text
Contact your bank using the number on your card
